MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The rivet nut assortment partly fits my interest in fastening hardware, reflected in my recent washer and metric screw assortments, though I do not currently need SAE rivet nuts.",
    "The tool box is a plausible companion to my hardware purchases because it could help store supplies, but I would only choose it when I need more storage."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Printer resin and filament require a printing need that my recent purchases do not establish, so none gives me a reason to interact now.",
    "The valve, pH meter, resistors, and electrical connectors serve plumbing, testing, or wiring tasks that do not follow from my recent fastening and hanging purchases."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The suggestions seem to treat workshop supplies as interchangeable, although hanging something with a magnetic hook is a different task from printing a part or wiring a circuit.",
    "Assortment packs alone are not enough to interest me; the parts must solve a relevant problem, not just resemble the kits I previously chose."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My two recent magnetic hook purchases suggest a more immediate interest in attaching and hanging things on magnetic surfaces.",
    "The specific fastening method and sizes matter: my metric screws and push-on washers do not establish a need for SAE rivet nuts.",
    "I rarely interact without a clear need, so even related fasteners or storage can be sensible matches without being something I would choose now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions partly recognize my hardware interests but stretch them into unrelated workshop tasks without a clear current need."
}
